boards.idea: a two-group ladder: the key must be reversed (A) to leave, its prisoner is itself a key and a flip target of B, and B's switch stands in the prisoner's exit - firing B to clear the lane turns the prisoner round
boards.source: hybrid: hand core frozen cell for cell (seed_K06_TWOGROUPLADDER.json, Phase 32); blocks added by the Phase 25-27 generator (tools/ta90_search.gd of commit c1ddc89, run in a separate worktree) --ops=v20 with the Phase 25-27 search parameters (piece_free 13, max_pieces 17, suffix_rate 0.30, patience 8), RNG seed 321, round 1 (K06_s321_2, fewer positions, failed the shortcut gate); every board then passed the unchanged modern pipeline: engine-valid tokens, bank overlap, tools/extreme90_screen30.py (40 ms gates, strict essentiality, filler, hint-follow) and the full evaluation tools/extreme90_eval25.py --full; shortlist rule S_old; Phase 32 protocol data/dev/extreme90_p32/protocol.json (the Phase 31 method, unchanged)
boards.related_bank_concept: closest occupancy N38 0.30 (bank); pairwise with the other Phase 32 boards <= 0.28
